workflows.behavior: walk 7 declared layer directories, validate .md/.py/.json/.yaml for a canonical header plus kebab-case filename plus component-ID format, append violations to telemetry/logs/governance-violations.log, print a compliance rate, exit 1 on any violation
workflows.name: Corpus compliance sweep

workflows.behavior: assert presence of .cursorrules, .cursor-commands, .l9_governance-config.json; assert .cursor-commands is a resolving symlink; assert config suite_version == 6.0.0; return a governance_enabled boolean
workflows.name: Workspace governance check

workflows.behavior: recount compliance over 5 layers (*.md only), sample host memory and CPU via psutil, INSERT a row into governance_metrics and optionally performance_metrics in a SQLite database under telemetry/logs/
workflows.name: Compliance metric time series

workflows.behavior: match the question against six regex intent families, then answer from rule-registry.json plus foundation/agents/stubs/*.stub.json; intents cover rule enforcement, kernel version, staleness, layer membership, rule coverage, escalation paths
workflows.name: Registry intelligence query

workflows.behavior: Flask app on 0.0.0.0:8080 with unrestricted CORS serves GET status/rules/metrics/health and POST validate/rules/learning; the dashboard polls status, metrics, and health every 30 seconds against http://localhost:8080
workflows.name: REST API plus polling dashboard
workflows.trigger: CLI (governance-api.py) then a browser opening governance-dashboard.html

workflows.behavior: run four unittest classes over compliance, integration, performance, and security, asserting tolerance thresholds rather than absolutes; import the validator and monitor from execution/validation and execution/monitoring on sys.path
workflows.name: Governance test suite
